source.label: Huan Huang and Natalie Baddour, University of Ottawa
source.description: Measured healthy and inner-race fault bearing run-ups. Each spectrum uses 60 encoder-measured shaft turns starting just after 3 seconds.

processing.resampling: Full vibration channel downsampled 1:10 with a centered Kaiser FIR (beta 5).
processing.window: Start at first interpolated rising encoder crossing at or after 3 seconds and keep 60 shaft turns.
processing.broadband: Welch density, 1024-sample periodic Hann, 512 overlap, segment means removed. 10 log10 relative to the joint maximum within the displayed band.
processing.envelope: Zero-phase Butterworth bandpass (N=4 prototype), Hilbert magnitude, then 450 Hz zero-phase Butterworth low-pass (N=8). Interpolate onto every eighth encoder edge.
processing.orderSpectrum: Remove envelope mean, apply periodic Hann, and take coherent-gain-corrected one-sided FFT amplitude. 20 log10 relative to the joint maximum across runs and carrier bands.
